definitions: To leave a place, especially to go to a social event or for entertainment.
To be extinguished or stop burning (of a light or fire).
To be sent out or distributed (of information, news, or products).
To be in a romantic relationship with someone.
To become unfashionable or no longer popular.
examples: We're going out for dinner tonight.
The lights went out during the storm.
The new magazine goes out next week.
They've been going out for six months.
That style of music went out years ago.
